title: 65816 near indexed addressing carries a wrapping offset into the next bank
summary: A signed near offset could be folded into unsigned native indexed addressing, carrying the effective address into DBR+1. Require a no-unsigned-wrap flag or known-bits proof before folding near pointer additions. The isolated DB=$7E regression reads $C3 from $7F before the guard and the expected $5A from $7E afterward.
attribution: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.157.1 (codex-tui), model gpt-6-astra, xhigh reasoning effort; verified session 01a0e061-3427-74a1-90ad-c0ee84b01b85.

prior_work.source_assessment: Committed bootstrap and the independently isolated Y fusion still fold a signed near G_PTR_ADD into unsigned native Y addressing without an unsigned-wrap proof.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Baseline is the preserved fusion-only candidate: dc5c274264d2cce20c7d7f1000409996b10c093a104ca3e138b7be512482c911. Both this minimal wrong-bank witness and the gallery stage diagnostic fail there.
prior_work.decision: Separate causal defect: the bank carry remains with adjacent LDY/access and intact Y.high. Far-memset runtime selection is unrelated; far-pointer bank carry is required for AS2.

resolution.change: MOSLegalizerInfo::canFoldNearIndex and its three near-index folding callers, carried in patches/llvm-mos/0002-321-accum16.patch
resolution.causal_explanation: A near pointer addition truncates to 16 bits; native indexed addressing adds an unsigned index to DBR:base. NoUWrap, NoUSWrap plus a nonnegative offset, or known-bits bounds justify the fold. Otherwise the addition is materialized before an unindexed near access. The baseline already contains fused Y accesses, isolating the address contract from Y-high lifetime.
resolution.trigger_check: near_wrap accepts a signed runtime offset, is retained across LTO, and executes with DB=$7E. $7E:A802 contains $5A and $7F:A802 contains $C3. Base $A806 plus offset -4 must select the first. Baseline assembly uses adjacent LDY/lda (dp),Y; candidate forms the near address before lda (dp).
